findings.evidence: `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean:64`, `:73`, `:105`, and `:115` restrict these facts to `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u,u} R`; the proof at `:107-111` is just `unit`, `hom_ext`, `BialgHom.coe_toAlgHom_injective`, and `Subsingleton.elim _ _`. `CommHopfAlgCat` already has the full categorical layer for Hopf-algebra functoriality in `CommHopfAlgCat.lean:49`.
findings.fix: First add the natural full-category declarations, e.g. `CommHopfAlgCat.trivial : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R`, `CommHopfAlgCat.unit`, `CommHopfAlgCat.counit`, and `CommHopfAlgCat.trivialIsInitial : IsInitial (CommHopfAlgCat.trivial R)`, then make the finite-type declarations wrappers via `ObjectProperty.homMk`/the full-category uniqueness result.
findings.issue: `unit`, `counit`, `trivialIsInitial`, and `eq_unit` are stated only for `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u,u} R`, but the constructions and uniqueness proof use only the underlying Hopf-algebra category, not `Algebra.FiniteType`.

summary: The finite-type object itself is in scope, but the categorical unit/counit and initial-object facts are proved only in the finite-type subcategory even though their proofs do not use finite type. Move the categorical API to the full `CommHopfAlgCat` level and derive the finite-type wrappers from it.
